document.title: Residential Building Construction Activity Guidelines
document.source_basis: CPWD DSR 2021, IS 456, IS 800, IS 1641, NBC 2016, Telangana Building Rules 2012

activity_master.name: Survey, soil investigation and setting out
activity_master.description: Topographic survey, soil bearing capacity tests (BH+SPT), layout and offset pegs
activity_master.productivity_note: LS: ~25 days for survey+SBI

activity_master.name: Mobilization and site establishment
activity_master.description: Contractor mobilization, site offices, stores, safety, welfare, temporary utilities
activity_master.productivity_note: LS: ~14 days mobilization

activity_master.name: Site clearance and temporary works
activity_master.description: Demolition of old structures, site levelling, compound fencing, access roads
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day: 1 gang clears 688 sqm/day OK

activity_master.name: Bulk excavation and earthwork
activity_master.description: Machine excavation for foundation and basement; dewatering, disposal of spoil
activity_master.productivity_note: cum/day: 1 excavation gang

activity_master.name: Foundation: PCC, footings and raft
activity_master.description: M10 PCC bed; RCC isolated / combined footings or raft as per structural drawings
activity_master.productivity_note: cum/day per crew x2 = 30 cum/day foundation RCC

activity_master.name: RCC frame: columns, beams and slabs
activity_master.description: M25/M30 RCC columns, beams, slab with TMT Fe500D reinforcement; centreing and shuttering
activity_master.productivity_note: cum/day per crew x3 = 60 cum/day frame RCC

activity_master.name: Brick/block masonry walls
activity_master.description: 230mm thick fly ash brick masonry in CM 1:5; 115mm partition walls; window sills
activity_master.productivity_note: cum/day per crew x4 = 19.2 cum/day brickwork

activity_master.name: Plastering and pointing
activity_master.description: 12mm cement plaster in CM 1:4 on brick; 6mm sponge finish on RCC; pointing
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x6 = 180 sqm/day plaster

activity_master.name: Waterproofing works
activity_master.description: IIR/APP modified bitumen waterproofing membrane on terrace; screed; wet area treatment
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x2 = 60 sqm/day waterproofing

activity_master.name: Flooring and tiling
activity_master.description: 600×600 vitrified tiles on floors; 300×300 ceramic wall tiles in kitchen/toilets
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x6 = 90 sqm/day tiling

activity_master.name: Doors, windows and glazing
activity_master.description: Teak-wood/UPVC door frames and shutters; aluminium glazed windows; grills
activity_master.productivity_note: no/day per crew x3 = 12 no/day doors+windows

activity_master.name: External finishes and facade
activity_master.description: External wall texture/paint; cement plaster finish; stone cladding (premium)
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x3 = 75 sqm/day external finish

activity_master.name: Internal painting
activity_master.description: Two coats putty + primer + two coats emulsion paint on walls/ceilings
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x6 = 240 sqm/day painting

activity_master.name: Electrical works
activity_master.description: Concealed conduit wiring, MCBs, DB boards, light points, fan points, power points, earthing
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x4 = 32 sqm/day electrical

activity_master.name: Plumbing and sanitary
activity_master.description: CPVC hot/cold water supply; PVC soil/waste drainage; sanitary fixtures; overhead tank
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x4 = 32 sqm/day plumbing

activity_master.name: HVAC works
activity_master.description: Split AC provision (residential); central ducted AC (commercial); ventilation fans
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x3 = 18 sqm/day HVAC

activity_master.name: Fire fighting and detection
activity_master.description: Wet riser, yard hydrants, portable extinguishers, smoke detectors, manual call points
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day per crew x3 = 30 sqm/day fire-fighting

activity_master.name: Lifts and escalators
activity_master.description: Passenger lift installation (machine-room-less); shaft pit, guide rails, car, controls
activity_master.productivity_note: lifts/day: each lift ~20 days install

activity_master.name: External development and services
activity_master.description: Compound wall, landscaping, paving, storm water drains, external lighting, gate
activity_master.spec_ref: CPWD DSR 2021 Part-I; Telangana Building Rules 2012
activity_master.productivity_note: sqm/day: 1 gang external works

activity_master.name: Inspection, testing, completion and handover
activity_master.description: Statutory inspections, occupancy certificate, as-built drawings, defect liability
activity_master.productivity_note: LS: ~10 days commissioning
